title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder
authors: K. Cho, B. van Merriënboer, C. Gulcehre, D. Bahdanau, F. Bougares, H. Schwenk, Y. Bengio
before: Neural nets scored translations produced by statistical systems.
problem: No neural architecture mapped a whole variable-length sentence to another.
breakthrough: An encoder RNN compressing a sentence into a vector and a decoder RNN generating from it, with a simplified gated unit.
why: It set up the encoder-decoder frame, and the bottleneck it exposed is what attention was invented to fix.
next: Bahdanau attention, by an author of this paper, removed the bottleneck a few months later.
inherits: The encoder-decoder shape still used for translation and, in modified form, T5.
